pageRules.pageFile: One file per page in src/content/pages/. home.json is the home page (/); every other file is named after its one-segment path (services.json is /services). Paths are lowercase words joined by hyphens, one level deep, and each is used once.

pageKeys.rule: "/" or a one-segment path like "/services". Must match the file name.
The page's search-result title, 1 to 70 characters.
The page's search-result description, 1 to 170 characters.
Where the page appears in the menu: { label, order, places }.
The page's sections, in order: at most 20.

menuKeys.rule: The words in the menu, 1 to 24 characters.
A number; lower numbers come first.

blockKeys.rule: The name of a block in this catalog.
One of the block's variants; the first is used when it is left out.
A lowercase name (letters, digits, hyphens; starts with a letter; at most 40 characters) that links can point to as /page#name. Unique on the page.
The block's fields, as listed in its entry.

status.live: The page is built, listed in the menu places it asks for, and in the sitemap.
status.archived: The page leaves the build, the menu and the sitemap. The file and its content stay, and setting it back to live restores it. A link to an archived page fails the check.

menu.rule: A page appears in the menu only if it has a menu entry. At most 6 live pages may be in the header.

pageRules.firstBlock: The first block must be a block whose position is "first" (the hero). It carries the page's one H1, so a page has exactly one.
pageRules.focalAnimation: At most one block per page may carry a signature (focal) animation.
pageRules.text: Text is plain. Only **bold** and [[placeholder]] marks are allowed. No HTML tags, no HTML entities, no markdown links and no control characters (line breaks, tabs, hidden characters).

allowed: An internal path (/name) or a path with an anchor (/name#anchor) that points to a live page, and to an anchor that exists on it.
"@booking": the site's booking link (the scheduler when set, otherwise /contact#book).

images.rule: An image is { src, alt } with an optional focus: center, top, bottom, left or right. The file must exist under /images/ and be a jpg, png or webp. Each image slot has a shape (3:2, 4:3, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9) and the picture is cropped to it; focus says which part to keep. The alt text must really describe the picture, so it can't be empty or only a generic word.

files.rule: A link may point to a PDF under /files/ that exists, such as /files/price-sheet-k3x9q2mz.pdf. Visitors download it.

video.rule: A video address must be from YouTube or Vimeo. The player is rebuilt from the video's id, not from the address that was pasted. Allowed player origins: https://www.youtube-nocookie.com, https://player.vimeo.com.
